notes.title: Check out the highlights of Ghostlore's new 1.1 Update!
notes.notes:
The 1.1 update focuses on making the item hunt in Ghostlore even more enticing and exciting. We started out by only wanting to include around 50 or so new Uniques/Mythic Legendary items in the game. But when we decided that these items needed to have unique visuals, we thought we might as well give a new pass to the character visuals as well. In the end, this update is quite substantial and well beyond the scope of just a bunch of new legendries, so here is a quick rundown of all the new features.

Visual Customization
Alright, so let's begin with perhaps the most obvious thing when you start Ghostlore with the 1.1 update: Your character can now change clothes. Gear slots have been increased from 5 to 10. You can now dual wield certain items and are not limited to just a weapon and a shield.

Personally as the artist on the game, I am most proud of the visual customization system. You can put together some pretty varied looks, don't you think?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/ebfb67b4ef0af8eaac4e29b527cc30e5510eb276.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/eed5d4a6b9c192ee32416abc48747ed9def1f237.png

Unique Mythic Legendries
The Mythic Legendaries are of course included in this update. Here is a sneak preview of some of the new unique Mythic Legendries that I have spent time 3D modelling. What do they do? Well I'd rather not say...it'll spoil the fun of finding out yourself.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/3d2ff83b4dce8f574851cffa16b0b08a5d5e3ad1.png

New Weapon Types
In addition to the Mythic Legendries there are some interesting new weapon types as well. In particular the Gauntlets and the Staff are the new starting weapon types of the Adept and the Geomancer respectively. They lend both of these classes a real martial artist vibe - something that was always intended, but perhaps never quite fully realized until now.
[previewyoutube=exXCKWVIDYk;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=vysUYCrf4cE;full][/previewyoutube]

More Inventory Space and Courier Pets
Inventory space has always been a huge concern for our players. With all the new item types, we were definitely worried that this time there would not be enough space to accommodate them all, so we decided to expand and redesign the inventory. Here you can see the new item slots (and admire a closeup of your character)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/8485cf9e14975e4df1e0f00f2468fb7c8f0e24c1.png

Also, we added a courier pet that can pick up gold and return to town to sell items on the player's behalf:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/ac6f109adc0b6a07046228233a5e908570241a0e.png

One of the courier pets, a Kumanthong, can be found for sale at the secret shop:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/ba0f50d4fac6cddba0e392cefa050e6ffca3721c.png
There are other pets as well, play the game to find out what they could be!

Ghostlore is now on sale
Ghostlore is on sale and we have discounted it to a low price of 40% for this time only. We will not discount it as much again in the forseeable future so get it now while you can!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783280/Ghostlore/

notes.title: 1.1 Update moving out of beta
notes.notes:
Hey folks, we've decided to move the 1.1 update over to the main branch in order to encourage more players to try it out. Thanks to everyone who tested it on the beta branch! You've been a great help. 

So far, the reception from our beta players have been positive. Personally, I do think this update breathes a lot of new life into the game.

To recap, here is what's in the 1.1 Update:

 New Unique/Mythic Legendary items.
 Various new weapon and clothing types. Dual wielding of certain weapon types are now possible. New Item slots for Chest/Waist/Legs/Feet/Rings. Equipping will reflect visually on your character. You can also now see a close-up of your character in the inventory screen.
 Expanded Inventory space from 40 to 64. New Courier Pet system where you can have a Courier Pet sell items on your behalf so you don't have to return to town.

SLIGHT GEM REWORK

The new item slots necessitated a slight rework of the gem system. The gems have been renamed and provide new properties when socketed into different item types.

Under the new system:

Fire Gem -> Ruby
Weapon: +Additional Fire Damage
Neck/Head: +HP
Shield: +Fire Resistance
Chest/Legs: +Minion Damage
Feet/Waist: +Accuracy

Ice Gem -> Opal
Weapon: +Additional Ice Damage
Neck/Head: +MP
Shield: +Ice Resistance
Chest/Legs: +Absorb
Feet/Waist: +Increased Minion HP

Thunder Gem -> Amethyst
Weapon: +Additional Lightning Damage
Neck/Head: +Skill Charges
Shield: +Lightning Resistance
Chest/Legs: +Minion Avoidance Multiplier
Feet/Waist: +Avoidance

Poison Gem -> Jade
Weapon: +Additional Poison Damage
Neck/Head: +HP Regen
Shield: +Poison Resistance
Chest/Legs: +Damage Reflected
Feet/Waist: +Additional Minions Multiplier

There are still some bugs lurking about that we are doing our best to fix. If you encounter any errors or crashes, please use the handy Upload Save feature that Adam has created. Doing so will email Adam a copy of your save file, where he can perform a thorough analysis and hopefully fix the issue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/fa92568c25296a077299a33663cf4a4c91b1af0d.png

Well, back to work. I hope to explain these features in greater detail soon!

Best,
Andrew

notes.title: 1.1 Update: New Unique Mythic Items, New Item Types and more now on Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Hey all, so sorry for the radio silence. 

In my previous post I promised to share progress updates along the way, but it turned out that the new features were much more ambitious than we'd thought. So we had to devote all our time to development and couldn't really share.

For now, here is what you can expect on the Ghostlore beta branch:


 New Unique/Mythic Legendary items. Drop rates for these items have been temporarily increased for testing purposes.
 Various new weapon and clothing types. Dual wielding of certain weapon types are now possible. New Item slots for Chest/Waist/Legs/Feet/Rings. Equipping will reflect visually on your character. You can also now see a close-up of your character in the inventory screen.
 WORK IN PROGRESS Expanded Inventory space from 40 to 64. New Courier Pet system where you can have a Courier Pet sell items on your behalf so you don't have to return to town.

I hope to discuss all this in further detail sometime soon, But for now our priorities would be further bug fixes and balancing. Big thanks to anyone who can play this on the beta branch and report any bugs to us!

Here's to having a wonderful Friday and weekend ahead! Please do check out the new update on the Ghostlore beta branch if you can make the time.

Best,
Andrew

notes.title: PROGRESS UPDATE: MYTHIC LEGENDARIES AND COSMETICS
notes.notes:
Dear players, we are currently laying the groundwork for many new features in Ghostlore. This is going to be the first of several progress updates detailing our plans to expand the game.

INTRODUCING: MYTHIC LEGENDARIES 
As mentioned previously, we are planning to add what in common ARPG parlance is known as ‘Legendary’ items in the game. As legendary items are already a tier of items in Ghostlore, officially these items will be known as ‘Mythic Legendary’ items in order to differentiate them. Here is a tentative list of Mythic Legendaries:

Vajra
Grants Thunderstorm at a random spot on the skill grid.
Causes sparks of lightining to emanate from enemies when hitting them with a basic attack.

Trishula
Grants Radiant Spear at a random spot on the skill grid.
Chance to summon 3 rays of light that deal attack damage when using a skill.

Sudasharna Chakra
Grants Chakram at a random spot on the skill grid.
Greatly increases area and damage of Chakram.

Kharga
Grants Blood Magic at a random spot on the skill grid.

Primordial Blade Asi
Chance to cast any available skill on basic attack.

Damaru
Chance to cast any available skill on block.

Jayantha Vel 
Grants Warp at a random spot on the skill grid.
Warp automatically triggers when taking fatal damage. Adds 3 chances. Greatly reduced HP.

Four Seasons
Grants special Glyphs that greatly increases elemental damage.

Teen Baan
Grants Pressure Point at a random spot on the skill grid. Automatically activates Pressure Point every 3 attacks. Arrows have homing property. Greatly increases accuracy. 

Badang's Stonesplitter
Grants Geomancy at a random spot on the skill grid.
Greatly increases damage of Geomancy, Stampede and Seismic Roar.

Badang's Earthshakers
Grants Stampede at a random spot on the skill grid.
Greatly increases damage of Geomancy, Stampede and Seismic Roar.

Badang's Heavyweight Belt
Causes an earthquake which does basic attack damage on block.
Greatly increases damage of Geomancy, Stampede and Seismic Roar.

Indrastra
Chance to cause a rain of arrows that deal attack damage when using a skill.

Pushpa Dhanu
Chance for enemies to become temporarily smitten and not attack you. They would still attack any minions or allies. Does not work on elites or bosses.

Ashwathama's Gem
When receiving fatal damage, casts every available skill at no cost.

Ruyi Jingu Bang
Changes the attack animation into one where you can attack while moving.

Wukong's Binding Circlet
Grants a special Glyph that increase damage taken but greatly increase Crisis Damage and Crisis Absorb.

Nimbus
Immune to movement impairing effects.

Nandaka
Greatly increases cooldown.

Agni’s Philosophy
Grants Immolate at a random spot on the skill grid.
Increased HP Regen.

Way of No Way
Gain a Combo meter that increases damage the more it is filled. The meter is increases upon skill usage, but decreases upon consecutive usage of that same skill.

Vijaya
Greatly increases Knockback and Pierce.
Causes fear.

Ekasha Gada
Greatly increases Knockback and Armour Break. 
Increased melee attack radius.

Thousand Cuts
Grants special Glyphs that greatly increase attack speed.

Sharanga
Grants special Glyphs that greatly increase projectile count.

Chandrahasa
Grants Shroud of Darkness at a random spot on the skill grid.
Shroud of Darkness' Eviscerate damages enemies around the target as well.

Mundamala
Minions explode and do damage upon death.
Decreases minion HP and increases their movement speed.

Phurba
Grants Excorcise at a random spot on the skill grid.
Excorcise autocasts linked skills every 5 seconds.

Legionhide
30% of damage taken is transferred and averaged out among your minions

Parushu
Grants special Glyphs that adds attack damage to skill damage when using skills.

Han Feizhi’s Unstoppable Force
Greatly increases MP.
Cannot be used with Han Feizhi’s Immovable Object.

Han Feizhi’s Immovable Object
Greatly increases HP.
Cannot be used with Han Feizhi’s Unstoppable Force.

True Taming Sari
Grants Taming Sari at a random spot on the skill grid.
Taming Sari gains damage from your attack damage instead of your minion damage.

Windfire
Grants Dashing Strike at a random spot on the skill grid. Greatly increases dashing strike charges.
Dashing Strike leaves behind a trail of fire.

Armilliary Sash
Creates Whirlwinds at regular intervals that deal basic attack damage.

Universal Ring
On basic attack, releases a swarm of ricochetting rings that deal attack damage.

Yin Blade
Greatly increases HP Steal.

Yang Blade
Greatly increases MP Steal.

Bhaumastra
Increased gem effect.

Khatvanga
Grants Ice Trap at a random spot on the skill grid.
Launches 3 icicle spears when attacking.

Phoenix's Blessing
Turns crows into Phoenixes. Phoenixes have the abilities of both Sunbirds and Doves.

Dragon's Blessing
Grants Guardian Spirit at a random spot on the skill grid.
Limit guarduan spirit to one, subsequent casts adds more heads to the Guardian Spirit.

Aruval
Increases critical hit chance by 1% for every second you do not land a critical hit. This effect is reset after landing a critical hit.

Jaivardhan
Grants Mind Over Matter at a random spot on the skill grid.
Causes an explosion at the end of Mind Over Matter's duration that causes basic attack damage.

Lord Shiva's Tiger Skin
Grants Weretiger at a random spot on the skill grid.
Allows skill usage as the Weretiger or White Tiger.

Vessel of Brahmari
Your minions are surrounded by a swarm of bees which drains their life, but damages enemies around them.

Brahmastra
All projectiles gain the homing property

Duyi's Grasp
Creates a trail of grasping undead hands the block enemy movement BUT allows the player to pass through. Allows players to create enclosures around enemies.

Kumaras’ Curse
Greatly increases reflect damage and missile reflect.

Karna Kavacha
Greatly increases absorb and avoidance.

Rudraksha Mala
Grants Mandala at a random spot on the skill grid. Mandala follows the player.

Nagapasha
Grants Poison Vial at a random spot on the skill grid.
Enemies in the area of Poison Vial are slowed

Yamapasha
Gain the affixes of the last elite killed for 20 seconds.

One of the things we've been unhappy with about the skill system is that a build only had a very limited set of combo skills to choose from. Since each combo skill requires 2 classes to access, 3 classes only allows access to around 5 combo skills. Another thing which we wanted to avoid was to find items which did cool things to skills but were useless to you unless you played that specific class. Many of the new mythic legendaries come with affixes which grant a skill (and sometimes change the way the skill works completely). These will affix a node on the skill grid with that skill as long as the item is equipped. These skill nodes can be used to access combo skills.

You might’ve also noticed that a good number of these come from Hindu mythology. In Hindu mythology, supernatural weapons are not just one-off artefacts. Instead, they are metaphysical ‘astras’ that can be invoked or bestowed. In one epic known as the Mahabharata, the legendary figure Ashwatthama managed to summon a weapon of the god Brahma from just a blade of grass. Lore-wise, this means we have an in-universe explanation as to why duplicates of Mythical Legendary Items can exist. If you read the Classified Reports, you will know that Ghostlore also goes through some length to justify in-universe why random loot drops happen, and why people fight with swords and bows when post-industrial revolution technology exists.

SLAY DEMONS IN STYLE

In addition, to make Mythic Legendary items feel more special, many of them will have unique graphics. 

Because of all this, it was necessary for us to re-visit the player character’s 3D model to make these new graphics and animations. 

While we're at it, we thought it'd be good to give the players a bit more customisation options too.  Here is a sneak peek: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/89fc805db7e8bb69d517fc45c425566f78e41ac8.png
Yes, Ghostlore’s graphics are actually 3D models pre-rendered into spritesheets at a very low resolution. But that's another story for another time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/43a61b7558a37bf2bbd630a5654775c2e88a3356.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/292b5c11111947d61e13491d22577bb547b03b59.png
We also plan to change the UI to be able to showcase a turnaround of your character:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/ec22a9bbbd47984410869861d3614e74f7e70fac.png
Please bear in mind that all this is still work-in-progress. Things might change, be expanded upon, or even left on the cutting room floor if we cannot manage it (hopefully we can). We set ourselves a deadline to get all new features out by August. We have other exciting features planned, but this update has gone on for long enough. Please look forward to what we have to share next time!

Andrew

notes.title: Update 1.015
notes.notes:
Work on Legendary Items

One of the most requested features for Ghostlore are 'Legendary' items in the usual ARPG sense, where they have fixed affixes that may be designed around a certain theme, or intended to support a certain build.

I am currently trying to brainstorm ideas for these new legendaries for the update. I would like to ask if anyone has any memorable experiences with specific legendary items in other ARPGs, such as Path of Exile, Diablo Series, Grim Dawn, Torchlight and Last Epoch.

It would be super super helpful if you can any ideas either here or in our Discord. I hope to be inspired by hearing what the community wants and try to adapt it into Ghostlore. THANK YOU 🙏

Andrew

notes.title: Ghostlore 1.0 release
notes.notes:
Ghostlore has come a long way since it's Early Access launch around this time last year. We launched with only half of the total planned locations in our game. Our only initial promise was to finish up all the locations in the main story and do some minor bugfixing and polishing. We worked hard to release a new map every month and by September, the game was story complete.

We didn't just stop there, however. Based on player feedback, we decided to spend the remaining months to go beyond the initial scope of the project, and implement major overhaul and expansion of the skill system and end-game systems. Here's a quick look back in case you missed it:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1783280/announcements/detail/3430079961712346390
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1783280/announcements/detail/3654144191653657037

Although the development of Ghostlore in this current state started in 2020 when the COVID lockdowns enabled work-from-home, I spent the year before that working solo, spending my nights and weekends to create a prototype, and before that, learning the basics of how to create a game. 

But even going as far back as my teenage years - even though the final vision was never a hundred percent clear to me - I had always dreamed of creating an action RPG. It was the reason why I went to university to study digital art and animation. 

So Ghostlore is the fulfilment of a lifelong dream. It has been a long journey. Longer than I can express.

I am grateful to Adam, who I would say is half of what this current incarnation of Ghostlore is, using his programming skills to bring the world of Ghostlore to life in a much more fully realised form than I would have been able to do alone.

I am grateful to Sarah who signal-boosted Ghostlore and grew the community on various platforms, and provided me with networking opportunities as well as help navigating business contracts.

I am grateful to everyone else who contributed in the early days, before the game was even called Ghostlore, and to my family, who provided me with the lucky circumstances that enabled me to work on the game without having to worry about debt or illness.

And most of all, I am grateful for all the players who have bought, played, and even streamed the game during its Early Access period. Ghostlore is not going to be a game for everyone, but for those of you who get it, get it, and are able to sink hundreds of hours into the game. 

Each and every one of you is important to us, and we have done our very best to fix the bugs you reported and implement the features you requested, to make Ghostlore the best action-RPG experience we could provide.

...

…Well, what more can I say? Ghostlore is on a 25% launch discount, so get it while you can! 

You don’t just have to listen to me though, you can check out what Splattercat and Tenkiei have to say about Ghostlore:

[previewyoutube=4taTAMsdPcE;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=PHak7HOpbc4;full][/previewyoutube]

POST LAUNCH PLANS
Adam and I still have some cool ideas we would like to explore, especially when it comes to itemization. There are plans for more varied visual customization as well. We are aware of various balance issues, especially with the end game. We would also like to flesh out basic attacks more. We will continue to fix any bugs that are found. In addition, we are aware that online co-op is a highly requested feature, but it is a lot of effort and not something we can afford to do unless the game does well.

Currently however, I am tired and I am sure Adam is too. We would like to take a break from active development. In the meantime, we hope players will be able to enjoy all Ghostlore 1.0 has to offer. 

Thank you and see you in Seaport!

Best,
Andrew

notes.title: MAJOR POST-GAME UPDATE AND PLAN FOR FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
In just a few short months, Ghostlore will be entering full release. This will be the last major update before then, and we have A LOT to talk about. Stay a while and listen.


NEW POST-GAME: THE INSTITUTE OF PARANORMAL STUDIES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/4b5bbbbffe80d53d874fd2526fda07cb46bb70aa.png

The Institute of Paranormal Studies is a futuristic location that serves as a new post-game hub where the player can undertake missions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/ad77be7ba8266b4d416e651425c8ca4ae2b548cf.png

At the institute, the player is presented with a random selection missions. Each mission has map modifiers which are also random, such as the amount of monsters/champions/elites that spawn, level of monsters, chance to find items, the size of the map, and so on.

In addition, Nadir will officially tell you to investigate Hell Gate Island. But in order to enter the Hell Gate, you now require a currency known as Hell Notes, which can only be found in Mission Maps. Once you are in Hell Gate Island, keep a lookout for rare items known as Map Data, which allow you to add further modifiers to your mission maps and change the odds more to your favour. The deeper you go into Hell Gate Island, the more slots for Map Data you unlock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/236bf2903a797aa04813976e4943a70625a923d5.png


HELLFORGE

Besides Map Data, Hell Ingots are another rare drop that could be found only on Hell Gate Island. Hell Ingots are used as currency in the Hellforge, which allows you to reroll affixes on your items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/83f445b7d9f5169ad7530f062670517ab3f765f6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/725a9b50ce4a16582ddaf5d476ae33fd80e45d3a.png


WEAPON AWAKENING

Remember the young girl you rescued from the Abandoned Old Hospital? She is the Psychic, and she provides the service of awakening spirits which lay dormant in items such as weapons, shields, hats, scarves and amulets (but not glyphs).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/6147254a27f4584f12fd58860b4f5e348d9b7631.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/4fb0b0033bcaa44959dcae8db37b275df4fd19f9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/3dafed75735c6dae753aa2dcc9626dacc0c219fb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/32c5d57293dcb5843e0a2397efdc52aec7b8994a.png

Awakened Items have an additional line of text and an objective to kill ‘X’ of a certain type of elite monster. After the objective is completed, the item will be granted an additional affix on top of existing affixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/7c84a7234645668c2196abc5b74ca277fd0e2757.png


THE ORANG BUNIAN

Based on actual Southeast Asian folklore, the Orang Bunian are nature spirits that you can meet in your travels. Interacting with the Orang Bunian usually provides a temporary buff.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/26563c43bbc5e917eba01b60d6cb039842e33f3e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/cc031c159f7d9f2e2f166960209462bf43b3c30e.png

However, on a very rare occasion, interacting with an Orang Bunian will open a portal to a hidden realm. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/ba6633c14ee69938ce6468b3e2bc05bf64732526.png

The Orang Bunian’s realm is a small, peaceful area with a large number of Treasure Chests. An Orang Bunian NPC crafter will bless an item of your choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/7109c3d86d7f0ad1734bd49db9428cd08bc66401.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/61de273dbf8f21310ecf2c3bcf74f9a16c2a3a72.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/cd2717bfbf0de0713b71eb1d724025c1db81d60b.png

Blessed items, like Awakened items, provide an additional affix.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/c5cd2a68207adb3654424d8b33a39781e03cfc31.png


SHRINE OF SPIRITS

The Shrine of Spirits is a new asynchronous online multiplayer mechanic where  a 'snapshot' of another player's current character (also known as their 'Ghost Data') can be temporarily summoned into the your own game as an ally NPC. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/67a904d7a0909a25a4c8d568b54bc7cea92fda7a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/686ac018a761f83dfe87d67c6b203a99f366a207.png

Whenever you summon another player's Ghost Data to assist you, your own Ghost Data is uploaded for other players to summon. Much like the Shrine of Balance, the power of the assist you get is dependent on the how effective your own assists has been for players who have used the Shrine of Spirits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/f8e416a7c7d49a993f0b51b93b3cccd7c7a9d15a.png


Other changes
This update also brings about a whole host of minor improvements, far too many to list but here are some of them:


 Balancing of skills and skill modifiers
 Various improvements to pathing and map visibility
 Increased monster density in some of the more empty areas
 Simple glyphs can now roll alternative stats


IN THE NEAR FUTURE

We plan to launch the full version of Ghostlore on the first week of May 2023.

For now, our priorities are:

[olist]
 Tightening of controls, especially for alternate control schemes besides the default Point-and-Click, such as Gamepad and WASD.
 Balancing
 Localization and UI fixes
[/olist]
There are also some planned features we would like to add post release, but for now, there shouldn't be any more new systems added to the game, or major changes to existing systems.

Although we might be able to squeeze in some stuff that doesn't change the core of the game too much, like additional monsters ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/5c07222305a9f5bef3fb04f5649a73ff628ab960.gif


TO ALL OUR EARLY ACCESS PLAYERS

I would like to say a big thank you for all our Early Access players for creating such a wonderful community. A lot of the changes we have made such as the Skills Overhaul and this recent update was not something that was initially planned, but us doing our best to give our players the things they most want to see in a game like Ghostlore.

But alas, the time is nigh. From now till May, we must focus heavily on bug-fixing and polish. To this end, we would be very very grateful if players could reach out to us if they encounter the following issues, starting with the most important:

[olist]
 Problems with key rebinding on any control scheme
 Problems with getting stuck on the map especially at the edges or around corners
 Problems with skills not working as they should
 Oddities in the UI such as glitched-out descriptions, text overlapping or coming out of the text box
[/olist]
As usual, we're readily available on Discord, but as it is really really important to us that these issues are resolved, we will be starting several threads on the discussion board for people to post any problems they have encountered in the areas we have highlighted:

Problems with controller and button remapping? Report it here

Problems with default controls and keybinding? Report it here

Problems with WASD and keybinding? Report it here

Issues encountered in Maps

Issues encountered in UI

We are committed to solving these issues and making Ghostlore the best it can be, so players are encouraged to use these available resources to get your voice heard. The more problems reported, the more we can fix, and the better the game will be. Thank you.

notes.title: Map update, plus Skill Revamp sneak preview
notes.notes:
For this monthly update, we have changes to some of the maps, as well as a highly requested change involving Alkahest (finally!). We are also excited to share with you our plans for the skill revamp. 

Map Changes
We have currently made some changes to the various maps in the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/f3373b14a2b95084012aee62c28c57fcb309acdd.png
Pulau Pasir Puaka now has some industrial stepieces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/a8f263b6d94de15f7440a5901c43bf1ba75d4513.png
Batu Sinaran now features a crystal cave complex.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/b8ecf365f505ab5ed5f03d5820cf5ba9c857e9b3.png
The leadup to the final dungeon has seen an expansion too.

In addition to all this, certain maps have been redesigned to have more open areas as well. For those of you who have already tried the game but have not picked it up in a while, you might want to start a fresh save so that you can see some of these changes yourself firsthand. The game is also story complete and playable from start to finish. 

Changes to Alkahest
This is something that keeps slipping our minds, but we finally changed Alkahest so that broken down items give Alchemic Reagents (Impure Essence, Frozen Flame, Radiant Dark, and Demon’s Blood) that is proportional to the rarity of the original item.

 2x materials for Uncommon
 4x materials for Rare
 8x materials for Legendary

This month’s update is not as big of a change as the previous months. It is a bit of an interim before the big skill revamp, which we are still working on, but are excited to share more about below.

Skill Revamp

One of the main criticisms of Ghostlore that we see coming up in reviews, streams and discussions was how basic the skill system was, especially compared to other ARPGs on the market. Because of this, we have decided to do a complete overhaul of Ghostlore’s skill system to be more in line with what players expect and deserve. 

This new skill system is going to be complex, but we know that ARPG fans are discerning and intelligent, they rarely complain about a system being too difficult to understand. The opposite, however, is far more likely. Complaints arise when systems in long running franchises get dumbed down in order to appeal to the lowest common denominator. That said, the most important thing is to provide a skill system which is deep, invites players to think about their options and tradeoffs, and gives them a chance to showcase their ingenuity and creativity with builds.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/b7948c2fb3a5ebd12ae103fae3f37e38dea2905e.png

The idea for the Skill Link system came about when we asked ourselves the question, “what if players were allowed to build their own skill trees?”. We also looked at the comparatively more well-received Glyph system that we had for stats. Here is a walkthrough of the new skill system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/b4c554cbd5d492fa56b9b31fd98046414acf19d4.png

Each class comes with a “skill set”, a pool containing active skills, skill modifiers, and class bonuses. Skills must now be assigned to a grid in order to be usable. More grid spaces unlock as you level up. Things can be placed in or taken out of the grid at will.

In addition to their own active skills, each class comes with a set of skill modifiers that you can use to change the characteristics of any skill from any class.

Skill modifiers link together with skills both across and down. (see green highlighted area in image)

Some skill modifiers have tradeoffs. For example:

 Increased skill damage, but increased MP cost
 Reduced skill cooldown time, but reduced skill damage
 Increased skill damage, but you take damage on cast

In addition, some skill modifiers are trigger modifiers. Trigger modifiers allow a skill to be used automatically, as long as there is enough MP, the skill is not on cooldown, and the modifier’s specified conditions are met. Examples: 

 Trigger on Critical
 Trigger on Kill
 Trigger on Transform
 Trigger on Movement Skill

Combo Skills

Each active skill is also now able to combine with two other skills across classes to form an advanced skill that incorporates the characteristics of both base skills.  Combo skills are created when two compatible skills are placed adjacent to one another in the skill grid.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/67b6ad1cdf5a9d7c5ebfcd1df06c07a569050c41.png

For instance, the Exorcist’s Mandala, a skill which creates a circle on the ground where your damage and the damage of allies are boosted, could combine with the Adept’s Mind Over Matter defensive barrier skill to create Battle Aura, a skill which forms an aura around your character that boosts yourself and allies with both offensive and defensive properties. 

Alternatively, Mandala could also combine with the Sentinel’s Summon Crows ability to create Summon Doves.

Personally, I am most excited about the skill Maelstrom, a combination of both the Sentinel’s Chakram and the Geomancer’s Thunderstrike. The result is an electromagnetically charged chakram that levitates slowly across the battlefield while releasing sparks of electricity along the way. Fun stuff.

Class bonuses
Class bonuses are essentially the passives from the old skill system, but you now have 6 to choose from instead of just 4. They also now have a component that functions as Skill Modifiers. Much like before, Class Bonuses have an additional requirement of investing a certain number of active skills and skill modifiers from a single class onto your grid, before you can place them. 

Estimated Time of Arrival

This is a very big change and we will need another month to work on it. In addition to the required art assets, we are still iterating on the systems design and working out all the loose ends. For now Ghostlore is still 20% off, so get it before time runs out! You can drop by our Discord if you have any questions about the new system. Thank you!

Andrew

notes.title: Early Access Release + Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. I am Andrew and I am the main developer of Ghostlore. I would like to extend a warm welcome to all those who have joined us for this Early Access launch.

Giving Feedback
If you have a suggestion for things you’d like to see in the game, do join the Ghostlore discord as we are highly active over there. This is where being a small team works to our advantage. We are able to be nimble and responsive to player requests, without having to go through layers of bureaucracy as we would in a larger organisation.

If you encountered a bug, our programmer, Adam, has created a handy Upload Save feature:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41358888/5671033a5ec2738394b97de2feea9c2372725ebd.png

We highly encourage using this feature. It makes it a lot easier for Adam to pinpoint the source of the bug if he has a save file that he can dissect and analyse.

Alternative control schemes
When we first started developing Ghostlore, we planned for only mouse movement like in other ARPGs such as Diablo and Path of Exile. So, we were quite surprised by the demand for alternative control schemes like controller support and WASD. We have done our best to cater to such requests over the past month. We’re pretty sure that everything in the game, from movement to combat to menus, is able to be controlled via the controller.

However, do take note that the default point and click controls are still the best way to experience the game. This is simply owing to the fact that the point and click controls has had a years head-start of development and refinement, over WASD and Controllers, which were only implemented last month.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41358888/112744c71eb90eeeae15a8e5d6859a474064883e.png

New Maps and Enemies
Ghostlore currently has around 60% of the total maps and enemies planned. The remaining maps have already been planned out with almost all art assets completed. We plan to periodically release new maps with the new enemies and complete the storyline.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41358888/7fcfe5b7fb06ab783c8f4d8f3b245635191402c0.png

Fleshed Out Hell Levels
We plan to improve and flesh out the hell level mode until it is a challenging experience which can provide dozens of hours of fun on top of the base storyline. More procedurally generated bosses, enemies, and quests are planned.

Skills System
The original design goal of the skill upgrade system was to give the player control over as many parameters of a skill as possible. The initial idea was that, rather than a linear upgrade, you could adjust things like the damage radius, number of projectiles, effect duration and so on and so forth. We plan a major overhaul of the current skill system so that each skill upgrade provides a meaningful choice for players.

Improvements to items and crafting
Like with the skill system, we plan to expand and refine the current item, crafting, and food system. We plan for a deep system with many build options for beating deeper hell levels. Player feedback here will also be very helpful. 

Improved Steam Workshop and Mod Support
Currently there is mod support for advanced code based mods and simple changes to game stats and abilities. However there is no easy way to add new game sprite or audio assets. We plan to add further support for players to easily add new enemies, items, and abilities with their own sprites and sound effects.

That’s all for now. I hope you will enjoy playing Ghostlore.

- Andrew

notes.title: MAJOR QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It is almost time for our Early Access launch, and we’re pleased to announce that we have managed to improve upon the things we mentioned in our last update. We’ve implemented the tutorial messages, fixed up issues with the pathing, and controller support is better than before. WASD still has some issues with regard to ranged attacks, but hopefully it will get sorted out before our launch date. 

We are even ahead of schedule on some of the more highly requested features: Local Co-op, which we only thought we would get to after launch, will be present at launch. Also, we have expanded it to support 4 players instead of our initial goal of 2 players. Be warned however, that we have not thoroughly tested the feature, so play at your own risk!

One of the issues brought up on Discord by our Patreon Supporter, smattymatty, was that the inventory tends to get cluttered rather quickly. 
https://i.imgur.com/72Z4asg.png

We discussed the issue, and decided to implement a major QoL change known as the Commodity Cube. 
https://i.imgur.com/z2z0kVM.png
As per the description, the Commodity Cube essentially gives extra inventory space and automatically stores items such as food ingredients and potions. 

You'll receive the cube from Nadir after clearing the first temple mission.
https://i.imgur.com/otj56PL.png
https://i.imgur.com/cKbE2rJ.png
https://i.imgur.com/9dcnGhn.png
If you are past that quest, don't worry! You should get the cube automatically the next time you load your character.

On a related note, as requested, food items are now on auto-pickup with a handy alert message at the corner of the screen:
https://i.imgur.com/1XT0aqQ.png

Well, that’s all for now. The Early Access launch is really close so I must get back to work. Some of you might be surprised that we’re willing to implement such a drastic new feature so close to early access launch, but this is because we’re committed to taking player feedback. While it is tempting to think of Early Access Launch as some sort of finish line, we know that it is only the start of things, and will continue to take feedback and suggestions. So, keep playing! We hope our beta testers enjoy this new feature. 

-Andrew

notes.title: Addressing Steam Next Fest Feedback + Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, Andrew here. I’m the main developer behind Ghostlore. We have gotten a lot of valuable feedback from players who tried the demo during Steam Next Fest, and have compiled it to come up with our next steps. Here are the biggest areas of improvement that we’ve identified:

Controls
Many players have reported that it is tiring to have to hold down the mouse button to move. In the current beta build, you only have to click once and your character will path to the destination. We are looking at implementing other quality of life features, such as the option to restore controls to the default. Controller support and WASD is another thing that is highly requested, and is currently being worked on. Finally, there are also a couple of known serious bugs related to the re-binding of controls. These will be fixed before the Early Access launch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/c25ac1863bb1ad07a60316f989fea8aa18da2a56.png
Controller mock up

Procedural Map Generation
Currently, the procedural generation creates many gaps in the terrain that players can run into. This is not intentional and many players are finding themselves stuck in various nooks and crannies. We'll be tightening up the procedural generation so that there is a clearer distinction between traversable and non-traversable areas.

Tutorial
A lot of players have requested clearer instructions on how to do certain things which are not immediately apparent. An example of such is how to hold position and hold fire when using mouse controls, as well as how to buy or sell items in bulk. We plan to add a simple tutorial, as well as tooltips to convey features like these.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/db226facef7a4d61c8907dd81e114b6f4fd1bda3.png
Tutorial mock up

NPCs
Lastly, some players have said that shopkeeper NPCs blend into the background and they don’t realize that there are NPCs there. We will be adding an icon above the NPC heads as a visible indication that they can be interacted with. The icons indicate the type of shopkeeper, and will also be on the mini map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41358888/7b681fe8edb6e67b2c0163a858f11da43c81c586.png
NPC markers mock up

Other stuff
On a more personal note, our only programmer, Adam, has been called up to serve in the army for 2 weeks, from 1st to 11th of March. This means we have very little time to implement all of the above changes. For those who are not from Singapore, men here are required by law to serve a tour of full-time military duty, and for 10 years or so after that, we remain on standby in our civilian lives for when they decide to call us back. 

Because of all this, we have decided to push the Early Access launch back by two weeks, from the end of March to April 14th (PT). To make up for this, we will keep the demo running for an additional two weeks after Steam Next Fest, instead of taking it down immediately. 

For those who have tried our demo, your concerns have been heard, and we want to ensure that they are properly addressed. In the meantime, please keep the feedback coming as it will help to improve the game. Thank you!
